entries: Improved scrolling in the full-screen view: bursts of mouse-wheel or trackpad events are now coalesced before redrawing, which cuts CPU use and reduces scroll lag in long conversations and the artifact viewer

Improved `GEMINI_API_KEY` sessions to stop immediately when the Gemini API reports an exhausted daily quota, a project or billing-account spend cap, or depleted prepaid credits, instead of spending several minutes on retries that cannot succeed; short-lived per-minute rate limits are still retried

Fixed resuming a long conversation in `medium` or `low` verbosity taking many seconds and lagging while history replayed: earlier tool groups now appear already finished instead of each re-animating, and keys pressed during the replay no longer refresh a half-loaded transcript

Fixed the terminal or tab title changing to a string like `Ga=q,f=32,...` every time the CLI starts inside GNU `screen`, `tmux` (including iTerm2 `tmux -CC` tabs), or Zellij; the CLI no longer sends its image-support probe through a multiplexer, and `CLI_GRAPHICS=kitty` still forces image mode

Fixed Vim mode ignoring non-ASCII characters such as `é` or `中` after `r`, `f`, `F`, `t` and `T`, `fv` and `fV` in Visual mode leaving Visual mode instead of extending the selection, and `D`, `C`, or Visual `~`/`u`/`U` recording an empty undo step and clearing redo history when they changed nothing

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕捲動效能升級，長對話與檢視器不再卡頓
title.en: Smoother Full-Screen Scrolling Eliminates Stutter in Long Chats and Artifact Viewer

body.zh-TW: 當你在全螢幕模式下翻閱篇幅很長的對話紀錄，或是打開產出物檢視器查閱內容時，快速滑動滾輪與觸控板變得十分滑順。以前手指快速滾動時，每一次細微的滾輪訊號都會立即觸發畫面重新繪製，不僅容易造成畫面卡頓，還會佔用大量處理器（CPU，電腦負責運算的核心）資源。現在系統會先將短時間內連續觸發的滑動事件合併整理，再一次性更新畫面，既降低了運算負擔，也消除了操作延遲。⟦如同收發室把同一時間寄達的零散信件整批捆好一次遞交，不必每來一張明信片就專程跑一趟辦公室。⟧
body.en: Rapid scrolling with a mouse wheel or trackpad is now much smoother when browsing lengthy conversation histories or inspecting content in the artifact viewer in full-screen mode. Previously, every tiny scroll event triggered an immediate screen redraw during fast scrolling, which caused visual stutter and consumed heavy CPU resources. The system now batches scroll events triggered in rapid succession before updating the screen all at once, reducing computational overhead and eliminating lag. ⟦Picture a mailroom bundling scattered letters that arrive at the same time into a single delivery, rather than running to an office for every individual postcard.⟧

items.original: Improved scrolling in the full-screen view: bursts of mouse-wheel or trackpad events are now coalesced before redrawing, which cuts CPU use and reduces scroll lag in long conversations and the artifact viewer

title.zh-TW: 額度或預算耗盡立即停損，不再空等數分鐘重試
title.en: Immediate Fail-Fast on Exhausted Quota or Budget Without Minutes of Retrying

body.zh-TW: 使用金鑰 `GEMINI_API_KEY` 進行操作時，一旦帳戶額度見底，系統會立即中斷並回報，不再讓你乾等。以前只要遇到每日配額（quota，平台允許呼叫的使用上限）耗盡、專案或帳單達到支出上限，或是預付餘額扣光，程式仍會花費數分鐘持續重試不可能成功的連線。現在遇到這類確定無法解決的狀況會立刻中止工作階段。至於每分鐘呼叫次數超標這類短暫限制，仍會自動重試。⟦好比去自動販賣機買飲料，發現卡片餘額不足時機器會立刻提示餘額為零，而不是反覆吞吐卡片空轉好幾分鐘。⟧
body.en: When operating with `GEMINI_API_KEY`, the system now halts immediately and reports the error once your account quota is exhausted, sparing you from waiting idly. Previously, when hitting daily quotas, project or billing spend limits, or running out of prepaid credits, the application would still spend several minutes retrying connections that could not possibly succeed. The session now terminates immediately upon encountering these permanently unresolvable conditions. Transient restrictions such as exceeding rate limits per minute will still be retried automatically. ⟦A vending machine immediately alerts you to a zero balance when your card lacks sufficient funds, rather than repeatedly ejecting and swallowing the card for minutes.⟧

items.original: Improved `GEMINI_API_KEY` sessions to stop immediately when the Gemini API reports an exhausted daily quota, a project or billing-account spend cap, or depleted prepaid credits, instead of spending several minutes on retries that cannot succeed; short-lived per-minute rate limits are still retried

title.zh-TW: 重新接續長對話瞬間載入，跳過重複動畫不再卡頓
title.en: Instant Resumption for Long Sessions Skips Replay Animations Without Lag

body.zh-TW: 當你打開先前篇幅很長的工作階段繼續提問時，畫面載入的速度變得俐落許多。以前在 `medium` 或 `low` 的詳細程度（verbosity，決定畫面要印出多少除錯與執行細節的設定）下恢復對話時，系統需要花上數秒重播所有歷史紀錄，造成操作延遲。現在先前執行完畢的工具會直接顯示為完成狀態，省去逐條重播動畫的時間。在載入過程中敲擊鍵盤，也不會再重新整理只載入到一半的對話紀錄。⟦就像翻開已寫好的會議紀錄，大家能直接從結論處接著討論，不必把每位發言者的發言逐字重唸一遍。⟧
body.en: Loading feels much crisper when reopening a lengthy prior session to continue asking questions. Previously, resuming a conversation under `medium` or `low` verbosity required several seconds to replay entire histories, causing UI lag. Previously completed tools now render directly in their finished state, skipping sequential animation replays. Typing on the keyboard during loading also no longer refreshes a conversation history that has only partially loaded. ⟦Think of opening completed meeting minutes where everyone resumes discussion directly from the conclusion, without reading every attendee's remarks aloud word for word.⟧

items.original: Fixed resuming a long conversation in `medium` or `low` verbosity taking many seconds and lagging while history replayed: earlier tool groups now appear already finished instead of each re-animating, and keys pressed during the replay no longer refresh a half-loaded transcript

title.zh-TW: 終端機多工器標題不再亂碼，修復圖片探測干擾
title.en: Terminal Multiplexer Titles Preserved Without Mojibake From Graphics Probing

body.zh-TW: 在多窗格環境下啟動工具時，終端機與分頁的名稱終於能正常保留。以前在 GNU `screen`、`tmux`（包含 iTerm2 的 `tmux -CC` 分頁）或 Zellij 等環境中開啓命令列時，標題每次都會被改成 `Ga=q,f=32,...` 這類奇怪的字串。這是因為系統啟動時會發送圖片支援的探測訊號，因而干擾了終端機多工器（將終端視窗分割成多個獨立工作區的工具）。現在程式不再主動向多工器發送圖片探測指令。若你確定需要開啟圖片顯示，依然可透過設定 `CLI_GRAPHICS=kitty` 強制啟用。⟦彷彿廣播系統取消了開場時刺耳的測試音，螢幕面板上的節目名稱再也不會被測試訊號給干擾覆蓋。⟧
body.en: Terminal and tab titles are now properly preserved when launching tools in multi-pane environments. Previously, opening the command line under GNU `screen`, `tmux` (including iTerm2 `tmux -CC` tabs), or Zellij altered window titles to strange strings like `Ga=q,f=32,...`. This occurred because the startup sequence sent graphics support probes, which interfered with terminal multiplexers. The program no longer sends graphics probes to multiplexers by default. If you still need image rendering, you can force it on by setting `CLI_GRAPHICS=kitty`. ⟦Like a broadcast system silencing its harsh opening test tone, the show title on the display panel is no longer scrambled by test signals.⟧

items.original: Fixed the terminal or tab title changing to a string like `Ga=q,f=32,...` every time the CLI starts inside GNU `screen`, `tmux` (including iTerm2 `tmux -CC` tabs), or Zellij; the CLI no longer sends its image-support probe through a multiplexer, and `CLI_GRAPHICS=kitty` still forces image mode

title.zh-TW: Vim 模式多項修正，支援中文字元搜尋與選取復原
title.en: Multiple Vim Mode Fixes Support Non-ASCII Character Search and Selection Undo

body.zh-TW: 偏好使用 Vim 模式編輯指令與文字的讀者，現在輸入非英文字元或選取段落時順手許多。以前在 `r`、`f`、`F`、`t` 與 `T` 指令後輸入 `é` 或 `中` 等非 ASCII 字元（非英文字母與標準符號的文字）時會被直接忽略。在可視模式（Visual mode，反白選取文字的模式）下使用 `fv` 與 `fV` 會意外跳出選取，無法順利延伸範圍。當執行 `D`、`C` 或可視狀態下的 `~`、`u`、`U` 但沒有變動文字時，以前還會多記一筆空白復原紀錄並清空重做歷程。現在這些編輯問題都已修正完畢。⟦宛如操作高階文書軟體，跳躍搜尋中文字能精確定位，反白選取時不會無故中斷，就算誤觸沒有作用的按鍵也不會清空復原歷程。⟧
body.en: Editing commands and text in Vim mode is now significantly smoother when typing non-English characters or selecting blocks. Previously, non-ASCII characters such as `é` or `中` were silently ignored after `r`, `f`, `F`, `t`, and `T` commands. Using `fv` and `fV` in Visual mode inadvertently exited the selection instead of extending the range. Furthermore, executing `D`, `C`, or Visual mode `~`, `u`, and `U` without modifying text recorded an empty undo entry and wiped the redo history. All of these editing glitches have now been resolved. ⟦Much like working in an advanced text editor, jumping to Chinese characters lands accurately, highlighting text does not abruptly cancel, and hitting ineffective keys will not wipe your redo history.⟧

items.original: Fixed Vim mode ignoring non-ASCII characters such as `é` or `中` after `r`, `f`, `F`, `t` and `T`, `fv` and `fV` in Visual mode leaving Visual mode instead of extending the selection, and `D`, `C`, or Visual `~`/`u`/`U` recording an empty undo step and clearing redo history when they changed nothing

entries: Improved reasoning effort level for models with different support, selectable with `--effort` or from the effort gauge in `/effort` and `/model`.

Changed plugins placed directly in `~/.gemini/config/plugins` so that a plugin whose MCP server needs configuration variables now starts disabled until you enable it, matching plugins installed through `/plugin`.

Fixed Mermaid diagrams and LaTeX rendering as rows of garbled placeholder characters in WezTerm and the VS Code integrated terminal; these terminals are no longer assumed to support Kitty graphics and now show the ASCII fallback

Fixed copying text from the artifact viewer when `Copy on Select` is turned off in `/config`: the viewer no longer captures the mouse, so your terminal's own selection and copy shortcut work, and `Ctrl+C` goes back to interrupting or exiting

Fixed project custom agents in .agents/agents/ not being found or selectable in workspaces created in the Desktop App, in already-trusted workspaces, under execution with --agent, in headless (-p / --prompt) runs, and in the /agents panel.

title.zh-TW: 模型推理解析度支援分級，旗標與選單皆可自訂力度
title.en: Tiered Reasoning Effort Support for Models, Configurable via Flag and Menu

body.zh-TW: 當你需要模型處理繁複的架構設計或快速回覆簡短提問時，能自由調配思考深度就顯得格外實用。Antigravity 改進了不同模型對推理解析度（reasoning effort，模型產生答案前的思考運算深度）的支援，讓支援不同思考力度的模型能更精準切換層級。現在只要在啟動指令加上 `--effort` 旗標，或在對話中輸入 `/effort` 與 `/model`，就能從視覺化量表直接挑選適合的強度。⟦就像騎變速自行車依路況切換檔位，遇到陡峭山路時切換到高檔全力衝刺，平坦直路則換上輕檔快速巡航。⟧ 遇到棘手的重構難題時拉高力度，寫簡短測試或整理資料時調低檔位，思考資源運用更靈活。
body.en: When you need a model to tackle complex architectural designs or quickly answer brief questions, the freedom to adjust thinking depth is especially useful. Antigravity improves support for reasoning effort across different models, allowing models with varying reasoning capabilities to switch levels more precisely. You can now select the right intensity directly from a visual gauge by adding the `--effort` flag to startup commands or running `/effort` and `/model` during a session. ⟦Like shifting gears on a bicycle to match the terrain, a rider shifts into a higher gear for full power on steep climbs and cruises in a lighter gear on flat roads.⟧ Dial up the effort for tricky refactoring tasks and lower it for short tests or data organization, making your thinking resources far more flexible.

items.original: Improved reasoning effort level for models with different support, selectable with `--effort` or from the effort gauge in `/effort` and `/model`.

title.zh-TW: 需要設定參數的手動外掛改為預設停用
title.en: Manually Added Plugins That Need Configuration Now Start Disabled

body.zh-TW: 平時若是習慣直接把擴充套件檔案複製到設定資料夾，要注意這些外掛的啟用方式變了。以前直接放進 `~/.gemini/config/plugins` 目錄的外掛，只要內含需要設定參數的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器，往往一放進去就嘗試運作；現在它們預設會先保持停用，直到你主動啟用為止。這樣的行為已與透過 `/plugin` 指令安裝的外掛完全一致。⟦如同收到需要裝上電池才能運轉的新家電，出廠時預設切在斷電安全檔，一定要先裝妥配件並手動按下開關才會啟動。⟧
body.en: If you usually copy plugin files directly into the configuration folder, note that these plugins now start up differently. Previously, plugins placed directly in the `~/.gemini/config/plugins` directory would attempt to run immediately if they contained MCP servers requiring configuration parameters; now, they remain disabled by default until you explicitly enable them. This behavior now fully matches plugins installed via the `/plugin` command. ⟦Picture receiving a new household appliance that requires batteries: it arrives safely switched off by default, starting up only after you install the accessories and manually turn on the power switch.⟧

items.original: Changed plugins placed directly in `~/.gemini/config/plugins` so that a plugin whose MCP server needs configuration variables now starts disabled until you enable it, matching plugins installed through `/plugin`.

title.zh-TW: WezTerm 與 VS Code 終端機不再破圖，圖表改以純文字備援顯示
title.en: No More Garbled Graphics in WezTerm and VS Code, Falling Back to Plain Text Diagrams

body.zh-TW: 在 WezTerm 或 VS Code 內建終端機裡查看架構圖或數學公式時，畫面上不再出現一連串令人摸不著頭緒的亂碼方塊。過去輸出 Mermaid 流程圖或 LaTeX 公式時，終端機被誤判為支援 Kitty 繪圖通訊協定，導致畫面印出整排破圖字元；現在已取消這項假設，改以清晰的 ASCII 純文字備援格式顯示，確保圖表與排版內容都能一目了然。
body.en: When viewing architecture diagrams or mathematical formulas inside WezTerm or the VS Code integrated terminal, you will no longer see confusing rows of corrupted placeholder characters. Previously, when rendering Mermaid flowcharts or LaTeX formulas, these terminals were incorrectly assumed to support the Kitty graphics protocol, causing rows of broken characters to print on screen. Antigravity has removed this assumption and now displays them in a clear ASCII fallback format, ensuring that both diagrams and formatted content remain readable at a glance.

items.original: Fixed Mermaid diagrams and LaTeX rendering as rows of garbled placeholder characters in WezTerm and the VS Code integrated terminal; these terminals are no longer assumed to support Kitty graphics and now show the ASCII fallback

title.zh-TW: 關閉選取即複製後，成品檢視器釋放滑鼠控制並恢復快速鍵
title.en: Artifact Viewer Releases Mouse Capture When Copy on Select Is Disabled, Restoring Shortcuts

body.zh-TW: 當你在設定中關閉選取自動複製功能時，瀏覽產出的檔案內容不再被強制攔截游標動作。過去在 `/config` 裡將 `Copy on Select` 關閉後，成品檢視器依然會捕捉滑鼠事件，使得終端機原生的選取與複製快速鍵無法使用；現在檢視器已不再佔用滑鼠，終端機本身的複製操作能正常運作，按下 `Ctrl+C` 也會如期執行中斷或退出。
body.en: When you disable automatic copy on selection in settings, browsing generated file contents will no longer hijack your cursor actions. Previously, after turning off `Copy on Select` in `/config`, the artifact viewer continued to capture mouse events, preventing the terminal's native selection and copy shortcuts from working. The viewer now releases the mouse so your terminal's built-in copy operations function normally, and pressing `Ctrl+C` properly interrupts or exits as expected.

items.original: Fixed copying text from the artifact viewer when `Copy on Select` is turned off in `/config`: the viewer no longer captures the mouse, so your terminal's own selection and copy shortcut work, and `Ctrl+C` goes back to interrupting or exiting

title.zh-TW: 專案自訂代理支援修復，桌面端與無頭模式皆能正常選用
title.en: Project Custom Agents Fixed Across Desktop App and Headless Runs

body.zh-TW: 當你在專案目錄下配置專屬的輔助角色時，各個執行環境現在都能順利讀取到這些客製化設定。以前放在 `.agents/agents/` 目錄下的專案自訂代理，容易在桌面應用程式建立的工作區、已信任的工作區、使用 `--agent` 參數、以 `-p` 或 `--prompt` 執行的 headless（無頭模式，沒有終端機視窗的執行模式），以及 `/agents` 面板中找不到或無法選取；現在這些辨識問題均已修好，無論在哪種模式下都能直接指派自訂代理。
body.en: When configuring dedicated assistant roles in your project directory, every execution environment can now smoothly load these custom settings. Previously, project custom agents located in `.agents/agents/` were frequently missing or unselectable in workspaces created in the Desktop App, in trusted workspaces, when specifying `--agent`, in headless `-p` or `--prompt` runs without a terminal window, and within the `/agents` panel. These discovery issues have all been resolved, allowing you to assign custom agents directly in any mode.

items.original: Fixed project custom agents in .agents/agents/ not being found or selectable in workspaces created in the Desktop App, in already-trusted workspaces, under execution with --agent, in headless (-p / --prompt) runs, and in the /agents panel.

entries: Added `medium` verbosity mode to `/config`, between `high` and `low`, which groups related tool calls and thoughts into concise summaries (such as `Explored N files`) while keeping commands and responses visible; the Verbosity setting and each option now describe what they show

Improved Mermaid diagram and LaTeX rendering in the artifact viewer on Kitty-compatible terminals: artifacts are pre-rendered in the background so diagrams appear as soon as the viewer opens, images are uploaded once at a smaller size, and zooming with `Ctrl+=` / `Ctrl+-` no longer flickers between the old and new sizes

Improved the artifact viewer footer by combining the separate top and bottom hints into one `g/G top/bottom` entry, labeling `m` with the view it switches to (diagram, LaTeX, ASCII, or raw), and fixing hints that contain arrow symbols wrapping onto a new line too early

Improved terminal sandbox behavior so the agent asks to bypass the sandbox less often: it now knows sandboxed commands can read and write its own artifact and scratch directories, and it tries the sandbox first even after an earlier command needed a bypass
Changed the step title of commands that exit with a non-zero code from `Errored` to `Failed`

Changed how directory entries in `skills.json`, `rules.json`, `agents.json`, and `plugins.json` are scanned: an entry now loads only the items directly inside the directory, the same as a `.agents/skills/` folder, instead of recursively loading everything beneath it; to load a nested item, name it in `include_only`, for example `{"path": "shared_skills", "include_only": ["category/my-skill"]}`
Fixed pressing `Esc` while the suggestions dropdown is open interrupting the agent's turn; it now closes the dropdown, and a second `Esc` interrupts

Fixed Mermaid diagrams and LaTeX leaving a blank gap inside `tmux` or GNU `screen` when the outer terminal supports Kitty graphics; the CLI now falls back to ASCII diagrams unless images actually reach the terminal, and `CLI_GRAPHICS=kitty` still forces image mode for setups with image passthrough configured

Fixed headless (`-p` / `--prompt`) runs that streamed part of a response and then ended on a model or agent error exiting with code 0; they now exit with code `3` and print the `AGY_ERROR` line, and JSON error output includes the partial response, while multi-turn `stream-json` sessions still warn and continue

Fixed machines set up with the old Remote Control installer script crash-looping after an upgrade; when the CLI is launched by that deprecated background service it now unregisters the service and points to `remote-control start` instead of restarting repeatedly

Fixed files that subagents write inside their own Git worktree being treated as artifacts, which demanded artifact metadata and left `.metadata.json` files in the worktree; subagent worktrees now live under a `worktrees/` directory in the app data directory

title.zh-TW: /config 新增中等詳細程度，摘要工具呼叫並保留指令回覆
title.en: /config Adds Medium Verbosity to Summarize Tool Calls While Keeping Commands and Responses Visible

body.zh-TW: 當你交辦複雜任務給助理時，既不想被整頁的工具呼叫與思考細節洗版，又希望能看清執行了哪些指令與最終產出。在 `/config` 設定選單中，現在新增了介於 high 與 low 之間的 medium 詳細程度（Verbosity，控制終端機輸出多寡的設定）選項。切換到這個模式後，助理會把一連串相關的工具呼叫與思考過程，整合成像是 `Explored N files` 這樣的簡短摘要。所有實際跑過的指令與產生的文字回覆，依然會完整顯示在畫面上。Verbosity 設定本身以及底下的每個選項，現在都附上了說明文字，清楚標示各選項會顯示與隱藏哪些內容。⟦好比閱讀晨會的重點簡報，後台密集的資料調度被濃縮成一行要點，關鍵結論與交辦指令依然完整呈現。⟧
body.en: When delegating complex tasks to an agent, you might want to avoid being flooded with pages of tool calls and thought details while still clearly tracking executed commands and final responses. The `/config` settings menu now introduces a `medium` verbosity option between `high` and `low`. In this mode, the agent groups a series of related tool calls and thought processes into concise summaries like `Explored N files`. All executed commands and resulting text responses remain fully visible on the screen. The Verbosity setting and each individual option beneath it now include descriptive text clearly outlining what is shown or hidden. ⟦Picture reading a morning briefing: intensive background data operations are condensed into a single takeaway, while key conclusions and assigned instructions remain fully visible.⟧

items.original: Added `medium` verbosity mode to `/config`, between `high` and `low`, which groups related tool calls and thoughts into concise summaries (such as `Explored N files`) while keeping commands and responses visible; the Verbosity setting and each option now describe what they show

title.zh-TW: 成品檢視器圖表渲染加速，多工器環境自動切換文字圖表
title.en: Artifact Viewer Accelerates Diagram Rendering and Falls Back to Text Diagrams in Multiplexers

body.zh-TW: 在終端機裡開啟圖表或數學公式時，畫面載入與按鍵操作現在更俐落。在支援 Kitty 圖片協定的終端機中，成品檢視器（artifact viewer，瀏覽產出圖表與文件的介面）會在背景預先渲染產物，打開瞬間就能看見 Mermaid 圖表與 LaTeX 算式。圖片改以較小尺寸一次上傳，使用 `Ctrl+=` 與 `Ctrl+-` 縮放不再閃爍。檢視器頁尾將置頂與置底提示整併為 `g/G top/bottom`，`m` 鍵會清楚標示切換模式（包含 diagram、LaTeX、ASCII 或 raw），並修復箭頭符號過早折行的問題。在 `tmux` 或 GNU `screen` 內若圖片無法傳入，系統會自動備援降級為 ASCII 純文字圖表避免留白，有設定穿透者仍可用 `CLI_GRAPHICS=kitty` 強制開啟圖片模式。
body.en: Viewing diagrams or math formulas in the terminal is now smoother across loading and key interactions. On terminals supporting the Kitty graphics protocol, the artifact viewer pre-renders artifacts in the background so Mermaid diagrams and LaTeX formulas appear instantly upon opening. Images are uploaded once at a smaller size, eliminating flickering when zooming with `Ctrl+=` and `Ctrl+-`. The viewer footer combines the separate top and bottom hints into `g/G top/bottom`, labels the `m` key with the active switch target (including diagram, LaTeX, ASCII, or raw), and fixes hints containing arrow symbols wrapping too early. Inside `tmux` or GNU `screen` where images cannot reach the terminal, the system automatically falls back to ASCII text diagrams to prevent blank gaps, while setups with passthrough can still force image mode using `CLI_GRAPHICS=kitty`.

items.original:
Improved Mermaid diagram and LaTeX rendering in the artifact viewer on Kitty-compatible terminals: artifacts are pre-rendered in the background so diagrams appear as soon as the viewer opens, images are uploaded once at a smaller size, and zooming with `Ctrl+=` / `Ctrl+-` no longer flickers between the old and new sizes
Improved the artifact viewer footer by combining the separate top and bottom hints into one `g/G top/bottom` entry, labeling `m` with the view it switches to (diagram, LaTeX, ASCII, or raw), and fixing hints that contain arrow symbols wrapping onto a new line too early
Fixed Mermaid diagrams and LaTeX leaving a blank gap inside `tmux` or GNU `screen` when the outer terminal supports Kitty graphics; the CLI now falls back to ASCII diagrams unless images actually reach the terminal, and `CLI_GRAPHICS=kitty` still forces image mode for setups with image passthrough configured

title.zh-TW: 終端機沙盒降低繞過頻率，失敗步驟標記與 Esc 鍵行為修整
title.en: Terminal Sandbox Reduces Bypass Requests with Refined Failed Step Labels and Esc Key Handling

body.zh-TW: 讓助理在終端機裡自動執行各項指令時，安全防護與按鍵操作現在更符合直覺。終端機沙盒（sandbox，在隔離環境中執行指令以確保安全的機制）現在經過改善，助理要求跳出沙盒確認的頻率明顯降低。助理現在清楚知道沙盒內的指令可以直接讀寫自己的 artifact 與 scratch 資料夾，而且就算前面某個指令曾需要跳出沙盒，接下來的指令依然會優先在沙盒內嘗試。執行結束且回傳非零退出碼的指令，其步驟標題已從原先的 `Errored` 正式改為 `Failed`。當終端機跳出建議下拉選單時，按下 `Esc` 鍵現在會先關閉選單，按第二下 `Esc` 才會中斷助理執行，避免選字時不小心誤按中斷。
body.en: Running commands automatically with an agent in the terminal is now safer and more intuitive. With improvements to the terminal sandbox, the agent requests to bypass the sandbox significantly less often. The agent now recognizes that sandboxed commands can directly read and write its own artifact and scratch directories, and it continues to prioritize the sandbox for subsequent commands even after an earlier command required a bypass. For commands that finish execution with a non-zero exit code, the step title is formally updated from `Errored` to `Failed`. When the suggestions dropdown is open in the terminal, pressing `Esc` now closes the dropdown first, requiring a second `Esc` press to interrupt the agent and preventing accidental cancellation during autocomplete.

items.original:
Improved terminal sandbox behavior so the agent asks to bypass the sandbox less often: it now knows sandboxed commands can read and write its own artifact and scratch directories, and it tries the sandbox first even after an earlier command needed a bypass
Changed the step title of commands that exit with a non-zero code from `Errored` to `Failed`
Fixed pressing `Esc` while the suggestions dropdown is open interrupting the agent's turn; it now closes the dropdown, and a second `Esc` interrupts

title.zh-TW: 自訂設定檔改為僅掃描當前目錄，巢狀項目需透過 include_only 指定
title.en: Customization Configs Now Scan Top-Level Directories Only, Requiring Nested Items via include_only

body.zh-TW:
當你在專案中自訂技能、規則或外掛目錄時，現在設定檔的載入行為變得更精確可預測。在 `skills.json`、`rules.json`、`agents.json` 與 `plugins.json` 這類自訂設定檔（customization，用於擴充助理能力與行為的設定）中，填入目錄路徑時現在只會載入直接位於該目錄下的第一層項目，行為與預設的 `.agents/skills/` 資料夾一致，不再自動遞迴載入所有子目錄中的內容。如果你想要引入深層子目錄裡的特定巢狀項目，必須在設定項目中透過 `include_only` 明確列出路徑，例如：

```
{"path": "shared_skills", "include_only": ["category/my-skill"]}
```

⟦就像打開收納盒只拿取最上層的物件，若要翻出深層隔袋裡的工具，就得在領取清單上明確標出該項目的名稱。⟧
body.en:
Loading behavior for customization files is now more precise and predictable when defining skills, rules, or plugins directories in a project. In customization files such as `skills.json`, `rules.json`, `agents.json`, and `plugins.json`, directory entries now load only first-level items located directly inside that directory—matching the behavior of the default `.agents/skills/` directory—rather than recursively scanning every subdirectory. To include a specific nested item within a deeper subdirectory, you must explicitly specify its path via `include_only`, for example:

```
{"path": "shared_skills", "include_only": ["category/my-skill"]}
```

⟦Think of opening a storage box and picking only top-level items: retrieving a tool tucked away in a deep inner pouch requires explicitly naming it on the retrieval list.⟧

items.original: Changed how directory entries in `skills.json`, `rules.json`, `agents.json`, and `plugins.json` are scanned: an entry now loads only the items directly inside the directory, the same as a `.agents/skills/` folder, instead of recursively loading everything beneath it; to load a nested item, name it in `include_only`, for example `{"path": "shared_skills", "include_only": ["category/my-skill"]}`

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式串流中斷回傳錯誤退出碼，JSON 輸出保留部分回覆
title.en: Headless Mode Streaming Errors Now Return Exit Code 3 While JSON Output Retains Partial Responses

body.zh-TW: 把命令列工具放進自動化腳本跑任務時，最怕遇到程式半途出錯卻假裝成功。在以 `-p` 或 `--prompt` 執行的無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機畫面的自動執行模式）下，以前若串流輸出中途因模型或助理出錯中斷，程式仍會帶著代表成功的代碼 0 結束。現在這類異常會正確改以退出碼 `3` 結束並印出 `AGY_ERROR` 錯誤行，JSON 錯誤輸出中也會保留出錯前已生成的局部內容，多輪 `stream-json` 工作階段則維持發出警告並繼續執行。
body.en: When running the CLI in automation scripts, silent failures that masquerade as success are a major pitfall. In headless mode executed with `-p` or `--prompt`, streaming outputs interrupted by model or agent errors previously exited with code 0 indicating success. Such failures now properly exit with code `3` and print an `AGY_ERROR` line, while JSON error output preserves the partial response generated prior to the failure, and multi-turn `stream-json` sessions continue to warn and proceed.

items.original: Fixed headless (`-p` / `--prompt`) runs that streamed part of a response and then ended on a model or agent error exiting with code 0; they now exit with code `3` and print the `AGY_ERROR` line, and JSON error output includes the partial response, while multi-turn `stream-json` sessions still warn and continue

title.zh-TW: 舊版遠端控制升級後不再重複當機，自動取消廢棄服務
title.en: Upgraded Legacy Remote Control Installations No Longer Crash Loop and Unregister Deprecated Services

body.zh-TW: 以前使用舊版 Remote Control 安裝腳本設定的機器，在升級版本後常會陷入不斷崩潰重啟的無窮迴圈。現在當命令列工具被該已廢棄的舊版背景服務啟動時，會自動取消註冊該背景服務，並提示改用 `remote-control start` 指令啟動，徹底解決升級後反覆當機重開的問題。
body.en: Machines configured with legacy Remote Control installer scripts previously fell into infinite crash loops after upgrading. When the CLI is launched by that deprecated background service, it now automatically unregisters the background service and prompts switching to the `remote-control start` command, completely resolving crash loops after upgrades.

items.original: Fixed machines set up with the old Remote Control installer script crash-looping after an upgrade; when the CLI is launched by that deprecated background service it now unregisters the service and points to `remote-control start` instead of restarting repeatedly

title.zh-TW: 子代理工作樹檔案不再誤當成品，隔離存放避免殘留元資料
title.en: Subagent Worktree Files Are No Longer Mistaken for Artifacts to Prevent Metadata Residue

body.zh-TW: 呼叫背景助手平行處理程式碼時，專案目錄不再被莫名其妙的說明檔弄亂。以前在 Git 工作樹（worktree，讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）中寫入一般檔案時，系統會誤以為那是產物，強制要求附帶描述並留下 `.metadata.json` 檔案。現在子代理的工作樹統一移至資料目錄下的 `worktrees/` 資料夾，這個問題已經修好。
body.en: When invoking background agents to work on code in parallel, project directories will no longer be cluttered with unexpected metadata files. Previously, writing standard files inside a Git worktree caused the system to mistake them for artifacts, demanding descriptions and leaving `.metadata.json` files behind. Subagent worktrees now reside under a unified `worktrees/` folder in the app data directory, resolving this issue.

items.original: Fixed files that subagents write inside their own Git worktree being treated as artifacts, which demanded artifact metadata and left `.metadata.json` files in the worktree; subagent worktrees now live under a `worktrees/` directory in the app data directory

Improved `GEMINI_API_KEY` sessions to reduce behavior discrepancies with the non-API-key sign-in path

title.zh-TW: 輸入提示詞可用 @ 指名子代理，自動補齊快速對話
title.en: Mention Subagents with @ in Prompts for Fast Messaging with Autocomplete

body.zh-TW: 當你同時開了好幾個背景工作幫手，想要單獨插話交辦新任務，現在只要在輸入框打個 @ 符號就能辦到。現在新增了 `@<subagent> <message>` 提示詞語法，能直接把訊息發給指定的子代理（subagent，在背景獨立處理特定任務的助理）。打字時只要輸入 @ 就會跳出自動補齊選單，清單會列出目前正在執行以及已經完成的子代理名稱。例如研究助理剛查完資料，你直接打 `@research 幫我整理成三點結論` 就能繼續追問，不必手動切換對話。⟦彷彿在專案群組裡打出標註符號，選單立刻列出在線與已完工的全部同事，點名就能直接交代待辦事項。⟧
body.en: When running multiple background helpers and wanting to chime in with a new task, you can now do so simply by typing an @ symbol in the input box. The newly added `@<subagent> <message>` prompt syntax lets you send messages directly to a specific subagent (an assistant handling dedicated tasks in the background). Typing @ brings up an autocomplete menu listing the names of both running and completed subagents. For example, right after a research assistant finishes gathering info, you can type `@research summarize this into three key takeaways` to follow up without manually switching conversations. ⟦Think of tagging someone in a project group chat, where a popup menu lists all active and finished colleagues so you can assign action items right away.⟧

items.original: Added `@<subagent> <message>` prompt syntax to send a message directly to a subagent conversation, with autocomplete listing running and completed subagents

title.zh-TW: Vim 模式支援數字倍數前綴，多行與區塊操作一氣呵成
title.en: Vim Mode Adds Numeric Count Multipliers for Multi-Line and Block Operations in One Go

body.zh-TW:
習慣在終端機裡用 Vim 快速修整文字的讀者，現在不用再狂按同一組快捷鍵了。編輯器現在支援數字倍數乘數，在一般模式（Normal mode，游標移動與執行指令的狀態）以及選取模式中，你可以在動作、移動與運算子前面加上次數。常用的整行刪除、貼上、復原、游標跳轉到指定行或選取多層括號區塊，都能直接加倍執行：

```
3dw    # 刪除接下來的 3 個單字
2d3w   # 執行 2 次刪除 3 個單字
3dd    # 刪除 3 行
3x     # 刪除 3 個字元
3rX    # 將接下來 3 個字元替換為 X
3p     # 連續貼上 3 次
3u     # 連續復原 3 次動作
5G     # 移動至第 5 行（支援 [count]G、gg 與 $）
2di(   # 刪除外層第 2 層括號內的文字物件
```

⟦如同給常用指令蓋上倍數印章，以前得連按好幾次按鍵的操作，現在敲個數字加指令就能一口氣整批執行完畢。⟧
body.en:
If you are used to editing text quickly with Vim in the terminal, you no longer have to mash the same shortcuts repeatedly. The editor now supports numeric count multipliers. In Normal mode (the state for moving the cursor and running commands) and Visual mode, you can prefix actions, motions, and operators with a count. Common operations like deleting whole lines, pasting, undoing, jumping to a specific line, or selecting nested bracket blocks can now run in multiples:

```
3dw    # Delete the next 3 words
2d3w   # Run delete 3 words 2 times
3dd    # Delete 3 lines
3x     # Delete 3 characters
3rX    # Replace the next 3 characters with X
3p     # Paste 3 times consecutively
3u     # Undo 3 actions consecutively
5G     # Jump to line 5 (supports [count]G, gg, and $)
2di(   # Delete the inner text object inside the 2nd outer bracket level
```

⟦Picture stamping your frequent commands with a multiplier mark, turning repeated keystrokes into a single batch execution with just a number and a key.⟧

items.original: Added Vim numeric count multipliers so counts apply to operators, motions, and actions in Normal and Visual modes, including `3dw`, `2d3w`, `3dd`, `3x`, `3rX`, `3p`, `3u`, `[count]G`/`gg`/`$`, and counted text objects such as `2di(`

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式守護程序正常退場，背景耗時任務不再被提早中斷
title.en: Headless Daemons Exit Cleanly and Long Background Tasks Run to Completion

body.zh-TW: 用腳本串接命令列工具來自動跑任務時，最怕背景工作沒跑完就被砍掉、或是執行結束後卡住不放。在以 -p 或 --prompt 執行的無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機畫面的自動執行模式）下，以前程式退出後常殘留背景守護程序。這會導致讀取輸出的外部腳本一直等不到結尾訊號而卡死，現在常駐程序會在執行結束時確實終止。另外，以前助理只要閒置約 5 秒，就會誤把還在跑的背景任務直接取消；現在會持續等待背景任務完成，最長可等到 --print-timeout 指定的期限，上限為 30 分鐘。⟦跟自動化產線收工一樣，系統會等手上最後一件耗時組裝確實完工才打卡，下班時也會把廠房電源全數關閉不留尾巴。⟧
body.en: When scripting command-line tools to automate tasks, you never want background jobs killed prematurely or hanging indefinitely after execution finishes. In headless mode (an automated execution mode without a terminal UI) run with -p or --prompt, background daemon processes previously lingered after exit. This caused external scripts reading CLI output to hang while waiting for an EOF signal, but daemons now terminate cleanly when the run ends. Additionally, when the agent sat idle for about 5 seconds, it previously cancelled still-running background tasks by mistake. Runs now keep waiting for background tasks until the --print-timeout deadline, capped at 30 minutes. ⟦Just like wrapping up an automated assembly line, the system waits for the last time-consuming build to finish before clocking out, completely powering down the workshop without leaving anything behind.⟧

items.original:
Fixed headless (`-p` / `--prompt`) runs leaving daemon background processes running after exit, which could hang scripts reading the CLI's output until end-of-file; daemon processes now terminate when the run ends
Fixed headless (`-p` / `--prompt`) runs cancelling still-running background tasks about 5 seconds after the agent went idle; runs now wait for background tasks until the `--print-timeout` deadline, up to a 30-minute cap

title.zh-TW: 修復對話歷史資料庫損毀風險，改善上下文壓縮與串流穩定度
title.en: Fix History Database Corruption Risks, Context Compaction, and Streaming Stability

body.zh-TW: 當你同時開啟多個終端機視窗、或是進行超長篇對話時，底層資料庫與連線都不再無預警出錯。以前多個處理程序同時存取同一個對話歷史資料庫時，檢查寫入權限的動作可能會悄悄丟失檔案鎖（file lock，防止多個程式同時寫入同一檔案的鎖定機制），造成資料庫損壞風險。當對話過長觸發上下文壓縮（context compaction，自動濃縮歷史以節省空間的機制）時，部分情境下用於建立檢查點的工具設定曾遭到拒絕而導致壓縮失敗。模型串流回傳資料時，要是封包缺少外層回應信封，先前會觸發後端當機並以連線錯誤終止工作階段。現在這些資料庫鎖定、壓縮檢查點與串流封包解析問題都已修復。
body.en: When opening multiple terminal windows at once or having very long conversations, underlying databases and connections no longer fail unexpectedly. When multiple processes accessed the same conversation history database concurrently, checking write permissions previously risked silently dropping file locks (a locking mechanism preventing multiple programs from writing to the same file at once), creating a database corruption risk. When long chats triggered context compaction (a mechanism that summarizes history to save space), tool configurations used for compaction checkpoints were rejected in certain scenarios, causing compaction to fail. When the model streamed response chunks without an outer response envelope, it previously triggered a backend crash that terminated the session with connection errors. These database locking, compaction checkpoint, and stream packet parsing issues are now fixed.

items.original:
Fixed a conversation-history database corruption risk where checking the database file for write access could silently drop file locks held by concurrent CLI processes on the same file
Fixed context compaction failing when the tool configuration used for compaction checkpoints was rejected in certain scenarios
Fixed a backend crash when a streamed model response chunk arrived without its response envelope, which terminated the session with connection errors

title.zh-TW: Markdown 跨行檔案連結不再破版，符號連結正確顯示名稱
title.en: Markdown Multi-Line File Links No Longer Break Alignment, Code Links Show Clean Text

body.zh-TW: 在終端機裡查看模型產出的表格與程式碼清單時，畫面排版現在變得整齊乾淨。以前表格儲存格如果包含換行折疊的檔案連結，整張 Markdown 表格的欄位對齊就會歪掉破版；現在即使連結文字跨行折疊，欄位依然能維持精確對齊。另外，指向函式或類別等程式碼符號的檔案連結，過去常遺失自訂顯示文字，直接把長長一串原始檔案路徑印出來；現在修復後會正常顯示原本的描述文字。⟦就像排版整齊的型錄表格，即使品名附帶超連結且折成兩行，整欄格線依然筆直對齊，按鈕上也好好印著簡潔名稱而非冗長路徑。⟧
body.en: When viewing model-generated tables and code listings in the terminal, the layout is now clean and tidy. Previously, if a table cell contained a file link that wrapped across lines, the column alignment of the entire Markdown table would break. Even when link text wraps across multiple lines, table columns now maintain precise alignment. Additionally, file links pointing to code symbols like functions or classes often dropped their custom display text, rendering a long raw file path instead. This is now fixed so the intended descriptive text displays properly. ⟦A neatly formatted catalog table keeps its grid lines perfectly straight even when product links wrap across two lines, showing clean labels on buttons instead of raw file paths.⟧

items.original:
Fixed markdown table column alignment when a table cell contains file links that wrap across lines
Fixed markdown file links to code symbols dropping their display text and rendering the raw path instead

title.zh-TW: 登入行為一致化，未完成的企業驗證憑證自動清除
title.en: Consistent Sign-In Behavior and Automatic Cleanup for Incomplete Enterprise Credentials

body.zh-TW: 在不同登入方式之間切換、或是驗證中途斷線時，帳號狀態處理現在更順手。使用 GEMINI_API_KEY 環境變數啟動的工作階段，過去與一般登入路徑存在些許行為差異，現在已修復並減少兩者的行為落差。另外在進行企業帳號登入時，若在挑選授權或專案之前就關閉瀏覽器視窗，以前會殘留卡住的局部憑證（credential，記錄登入身分的授權資料）而無法重試。現在會自動清除未完成的殘餘憑證，讓你直接乾淨重試登入。⟦恰似訪客在發卡機前登記，若手續辦到一半中途離開，機器會自動收回未完成的臨時卡，方便下一回重新乾淨取證。⟧
body.en: Handling account states is now smoother when switching between sign-in methods or disconnecting mid-authentication. Sessions started with the GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable previously had slight behavior discrepancies compared to the standard sign-in path, which are now resolved. Furthermore, during enterprise account sign-ins, closing the browser window before selecting a license or project previously left behind stuck partial credentials (authorization data recording sign-in identity) that blocked retries. Incomplete leftover credentials are now cleared automatically so you can retry sign-in cleanly. ⟦When a visitor registers at a badge kiosk and walks away halfway through, the machine retrieves the unfinished temporary card so the next attempt can start fresh.⟧

items.original:
Improved `GEMINI_API_KEY` sessions to reduce behavior discrepancies with the non-API-key sign-in path
Fixed incomplete enterprise sign-ins (for example closing the browser window before finishing license or project selection) leaving behind a stuck partial credential; such credentials are now cleared automatically so sign-in can be retried cleanly

title.zh-TW: 成品檢視器顯示平移提示，回溯面板自動聚焦最新步驟
title.en: Artifact Viewer Shows Pan Hints, Rewind Panel Auto-Focuses Latest Step

body.zh-TW: 在終端機裡查看生成產物或回頭翻找對話歷程時，多處介面細節變得更順手。當大型圖表超出視窗寬度時，成品檢視器（artifact viewer，瀏覽產出圖表與文件的介面）會在底部顯示向左或向右平移的提示。開啟 /rewind 回溯面板時，各步驟會標上相對時間，並在面板打開時自動聚焦在最新步驟。在指令授權方面，白名單建議現在能精準辨識 jj config 與 jj op 子指令，方便你直接設定永久允許。瀏覽器隨行頁面的分頁標題也修正為大寫縮寫的 Antigravity CLI。這些介面與指令辨識的修整，讓日常瀏覽圖表與回溯操作更俐落。
body.en: Several UI details are now smoother when reviewing generated artifacts or browsing past conversation history in the terminal. When a wide diagram overflows the window width, the artifact viewer (an interface for browsing generated diagrams and documents) shows a Left/Right pan hint in the footer. Opening the /rewind panel displays relative timestamps for each step and automatically focuses on the most recent step when the panel opens. For command authorization, allow-listing suggestions now accurately recognize jj config and jj op subcommands when offering to always allow a command. The browser companion page title has also been corrected to the capitalized acronym Antigravity CLI. These interface and command recognition refinements make viewing diagrams and rewinding history much crisper.

items.original:
Improved the artifact viewer to show a Left/Right pan hint in the footer when a wide diagram overflows the window
Improved `/rewind` to show a relative timestamp for each step and to focus the most recent step when the panel opens
Improved command allow-listing suggestions to recognize `jj config` and `jj op` subcommands when offering to always allow a command
Fixed the browser companion page title to read `Antigravity CLI` instead of `Antigravity Cli`

title.zh-TW: 長指令不再被截斷，上下文壓縮依全篇對話分攤預算
title.en: Long prompts stay intact as context compaction shares budgets across turns

body.zh-TW: 和 AI 來回聊上幾十輪之後，你最開始交代的那一大段需求，它還記得住嗎？以前上下文壓縮（context compaction，對話太長時自動濃縮歷史以省空間的機制）時，每段提問都只能分到固定的字數上限。就算後面幾句問答都很簡短，開頭落落長的初始提示詞（prompt）也會被削成一小截。現在改由所有提問彈性分攤預算，只要後續問題短，開頭的指令細節就能完整留下來。摘要與截斷預算也改照模型完整的上下文視窗（context window，模型一次能讀取的最大容量）計算，不再依較窄的壓縮觸發門檻計算，濃縮後的重點與背景任務清單就不會被提早切掉。⟦就像會議紀錄員依照整場會議的長度來分配紙張，以前每位發言人只能分到半頁，現在後面的人講得短，開頭主席的重要報告就能整段謄錄，結尾的待辦清單也不會被裁掉。⟧
body.en: After dozens of back-and-forth turns, does the AI still remember the long brief you started with? Previously, compaction enforced a rigid length cap on every captured user prompt, lopping off details from a long initial prompt even when all subsequent follow-up turns were brief. The user-request budget is now shared flexibly across all captured prompts, preserving the full context of long instructions whenever later prompts are short. Summary and truncation budgets are also now calculated from the model's full context window rather than the narrower compaction trigger threshold, ensuring compacted summaries and background-task lists are never cut short prematurely. ⟦Like a meeting secretary who allocates notebook space across the whole session: each speaker used to get a fixed half-page, but now brief follow-ups leave plenty of room to record the chair's opening remarks in full without trimming the closing task list.⟧

items.original:
Improved context compaction to spread its user-request budget across all captured prompts, so a long initial instruction is no longer truncated to a small fixed slice when the other prompts in the conversation are short
Improved context compaction to size summary and truncation budgets from the model's full context window instead of the compaction trigger threshold, so compacted summaries and background-task lists are no longer prematurely cut short

title.zh-TW: 自訂模型支援 PDF，多媒體檔案不再報格式不支援
title.en: Custom models support PDFs and stop throwing unsupported mime type errors

body.zh-TW: 在 `settings.json` 裡掛了自訂模型，一傳 PDF 或音訊就跳 `unsupported mime type`？以前丟這類附件、或讓工具輸出音訊與文件，都會直接卡住。現在自訂模型預設直接支援 PDF，而且會確實讀取 `modelFeatures` 裡針對 images、video、PDF 與 audio 的媒體旗標，各類多媒體檔案都能依照設定正常送給模型處理。
body.en: Added a custom model in `settings.json` and got `unsupported mime type` the moment you sent a PDF or audio? Previously, attaching these media files or having tools emit audio and document outputs would fail outright. Custom models now accept PDFs by default and strictly honor the `modelFeatures` media flags for images, video, PDF, and audio, allowing media files to pass to the model as configured.

items.original: Fixed PDF and audio tool outputs and attachments failing with `unsupported mime type` errors on custom models configured in `settings.json`; custom models now accept PDFs by default and honor the `modelFeatures` media flags for images, video, PDF, and audio

title.zh-TW: 按 Ctrl+G 開啟 Vim 不再卡死，編輯提示詞直連終端機
title.en: Pressing Ctrl+G to open Vim no longer hangs when editing prompts

body.zh-TW: 想要在終端機裡好好寫提示詞，按下 `Ctrl+G` 就能跳進 `vim` 這類全螢幕編輯器慢慢改。以前按下快捷鍵時，編輯器常因為輸出沒接對終端機而卡死，畫面上還會跳出 `Vim: Warning: Output is not to a terminal` 警告，整個卡住不動。現在外部編輯器改在真實的終端機標準輸出（stdout）下執行，隨時按 `Ctrl+G` 都能直接打開編輯器，改完存檔離開就立刻回到對話。
body.en: When you want to compose prompts comfortably in the terminal, pressing `Ctrl+G` jumps into a full-screen editor like `vim`. Previously, pressing this shortcut could freeze the editor with a `Vim: Warning: Output is not to a terminal` warning because its output was not connected to a real terminal. External editors now run against a real terminal stdout, so pressing `Ctrl+G` opens your editor immediately and returns you to the conversation as soon as you save and exit.

items.original: Fixed pressing `Ctrl+G` to edit the prompt in a full-screen terminal editor such as `vim` hanging with `Vim: Warning: Output is not to a terminal`; external editors now run against a real terminal stdout

title.zh-TW: 語音聽寫超時草稿不再被清空，錄音滿三分半自動完成轉錄
title.en: Voice dictation no longer erases drafts on timeout and auto-finalizes at 3.5 minutes

body.zh-TW: 對著麥克風講了一大段需求，結果一個字都沒留下？以前錄音只要超過 4 分鐘，就會觸發時限錯誤直接宣告失敗，講了老半天的轉錄草稿也跟著全部消失。現在錄音只要滿 3 分 30 秒就會自動停止並完成轉錄，講完的內容會好好轉成文字，不再怕超時白講一場。
body.en: Talked into the mic at length, only to end up with nothing? Previously, recordings exceeding 4 minutes triggered a deadline error and failed completely, discarding the entire drafted transcript. Recordings now automatically stop and finalize at 3 minutes 30 seconds, reliably converting your spoken words into text so you never lose your progress.

items.original: Fixed voice dictation sessions longer than 4 minutes failing with a deadline error and erasing the drafted transcription; recordings now automatically stop and finalize at 3 minutes 30 seconds

title.zh-TW: 非企業帳號登入時不再看到 Google Cloud 的 Project ID
title.en: Personal sign-ins no longer see a Google Cloud Project ID

body.zh-TW: 只是用個人帳號登入，啟動畫面卻冒出一串看不懂的雲端專案代碼？以前非企業的個人帳號登入時，終端機頂端的啟動橫幅會誤印出 Google Cloud 專案代碼（Project ID）。現在修好了，個人帳號登入時不會再看到這串跟你無關的代碼。
body.en: Signed in with a personal account and saw a cryptic cloud project ID on the startup screen? Previously, non-enterprise personal sign-ins mistakenly showed a Google Cloud Project ID in the startup banner at the top of the terminal. This is now fixed, so personal sign-ins no longer see an ID that has nothing to do with them.

items.original: Fixed the startup banner displaying a Google Cloud Project ID for consumer (non-enterprise) sign-ins

title.zh-TW: 複雜步驟對話載入不再當機，分岔對話徹底隔離舊資料
title.en: Complex conversation steps load without crashes and forked histories stay cleanly isolated

body.zh-TW: 對話裡有子代理、排程這類步驟，重新打開時整個程式崩潰？以前對話裡只要有背景任務、子代理管理、訊息傳遞或排程步驟，重新載入或壓縮對話時就容易觸發堆疊溢位（stack-overflow，記憶體堆疊空間耗盡導致當機）而整台程式崩潰。另外，把對話分岔（fork，從既有對話的某個時間點複製出新分支）時，新分支以前會誤把分岔點之後的舊步驟輸出抄進來，跟分岔後產生的新步驟打架。現在這兩處都已修好，載入不再崩潰，分岔後的資料也乾淨隔開。⟦翻開厚厚的工作企劃夾，重讀多組交辦與排程紀錄時不會讓活頁夾散掉，從中途另存一份新企劃時，也不會把原本後半段的舊進度混進新計畫裡。⟧
body.en: Did reopening a conversation with subagent or scheduling steps crash the whole program? Previously, reloading or compacting conversations containing background-task, subagent-management, messaging, or scheduling steps could trigger a stack-overflow crash that halted the program. In addition, when forking a conversation, the new branch mistakenly inherited step output data from steps after the fork point, clashing with freshly generated steps. Both issues are now resolved: loading no longer crashes and forked histories stay cleanly separated. ⟦Picture a thick project binder: reviewing multi-team handoffs and schedules no longer bursts the binder rings, and branching a new draft midway stops old downstream milestones from cluttering the new plan.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a stack-overflow crash when loading or compacting conversations containing background-task, subagent-management, messaging, or scheduling steps
Fixed forked conversations inheriting step output data from steps after the fork point, which could collide with new steps produced in the fork

title.zh-TW: 修復背景資源洩漏，中途取消與結束程式都不再拖泥帶水
title.en: Background leaks fixed, canceled requests abort instantly, and CLI quits without delay

body.zh-TW: 命令列工具開了一整天，或是中途取消建立工作區，背景都不會再偷偷累積記憶體或霸佔資源。以前每個對話工作階段（session）都會漏掉背景輪詢器與計時器，開越久記憶體吃越多。要是你中途取消建立對話或工作區，背景還會傻傻繼續調度資源，現在只要取消就會立刻中止作業。想關掉工具離開時，以前也得乾等 5 秒強制逾時才能結束，現在關閉時會直接中斷未結的串流連線，按退出就能秒關。以前開久了電腦變慢、取消還佔資源、退出又得乾等的麻煩，現在一次全清乾淨了。
body.en: Running the CLI all day or canceling workspace creation will no longer leak memory or hold onto orphaned resources in the background. Previously, every conversation session leaked a background poller and timer, steadily accumulating memory over long sessions. If you canceled a conversation or workspace creation, the background continued provisioning resources; aborted requests now halt immediately. Quitting the CLI also used to force an extra 5-second wait for a timeout, but shutdown now severs open streaming connections immediately to exit on the spot. Sluggish memory bloat, stuck background provisioning, and slow exits are all resolved.

items.original:
Fixed a background poller and timer leaking for every conversation session, slowly accumulating memory over long-running sessions
Fixed canceled conversation and workspace creation requests continuing to provision resources in the background; aborted requests now stop immediately
Fixed quitting the CLI taking around 5 extra seconds before the process exited; shutdown now cancels open streaming connections immediately instead of waiting for a forced timeout
